sources.title: Sussex County Republican Committee districts and leadership

coverage_note: Ten representative district chair positions are listed. The party says each election district has two committeepersons, but their seat status has not been documented here, so this is not a complete county seat count.
notes: The county party's live leadership page was checked November 27, 2026. It marks three representative district chairs vacant. Vice chairs are not included because the party says those positions exist only in some districts. Election district committeeperson seats are not included. This partial list is excluded from state seat totals.
